tools.name: usdctofiat_routes
tools.description: USDC seller rates and live listed depth on usdctofiat.xyz for one currency, optionally one payout app. Past fills, not a quote. Returns a prefilled sell link per route; selling happens on the site from the user's own wallet.

tools.name: usdctofiat_best_route
tools.description: Use when someone wants to cash out, off-ramp or sell USDC for fiat. Returns the main ways to turn an amount of USDC into one fiat currency, ranked by cash received: peer-to-peer on usdctofiat.xyz (paid to Revolut, Monzo, Venmo, Cash App, Zelle, PayPal and others), exchanges, off-ramps, direct deposi

tools.name: usdctofiat_sell_link
tools.description: A link that opens the usdctofiat.xyz sell form prefilled with an amount of USDC, a currency, a payment app and a speed (fast: market rate; best: managed rate). Without a payment app, the peer-to-peer route that pays most in the comparison is used; without a speed, the one behind that app's figure in

tools.name: usdctofiat_order_status
tools.description: Use to check on a cash-out the user already started on usdctofiat.xyz, for example "has my order filled?" or "where is my money?". Give the Base wallet address they sold from (a public 0x address; never ask for a seed phrase or private key) and get that seller's deposits as the site's Deposits page

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "usdctofiat_order_status" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
